BrochureContent.Content:
Flynn Estate Agents are delighted to bring number 60 Ridgewood Square, Swords to the open market for sale. Set in the heart of the ever-popular Ridgewood development, this beautifully maintained 3 bed, 2 bath end-of-terrace home enjoys a quiet position within a well-established and highly sought-after community. Offered with vacant possession and available for immediate occupancy, it represents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, growing families, or those looking to downsize to a low-maintenance home in a peaceful setting.

Inside, the accommodation is both spacious and thoughtfully laid out. A welcoming entrance hallway with a convenient guest WC leads into a bright and airy front lounge, while to the rear, the open-plan kitchen and dining area enjoys seamless access to the south-facing patio, creating an ideal setting for everyday living and entertaining alike. Upstairs, there are three generously sized bedrooms, all benefiting from excellent built-in wardrobe space. A well-appointed family bathroom completes the accommodation.

Externally, the property enjoys a prime position overlooking a large green area to the front, enhancing the sense of space and tranquillity. To the rear, a private south-facing patio captures sunlight throughout the day and offers the perfect space for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing in peaceful surroundings. Residents also benefit from access to a communal green space, further enhancing the lifestyle on offer. On-street parking is readily available to the front with two parking spaces allocated.

Superbly located just a 10 minute walk to Swords Village, Pavilion Shopping Centre & an abundance of amenities including shops, bars, restaurants, schools, crèche, gyms`, parks and sporting facilities. Ridgewood Estate itself also benefits from an on-site crèche, Tesco Express and pharmacy, offering excellent convenience for residents.There are also frequent running bus routes just a minutes stroll from your doorstep including the Swords Express Service linking Dublin City Centre in 15 minutes door to door. A mere stone`s+ throw from Airside Business & Retail Park, M50 / M1 Motorways & Dublin International Airport.
